culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: On customary land, the custom gesture (geste coutumier) is how you introduce yourself and ask permission to enter a tribe: present yourself to the chief or petit chef, explain why you have come, and offer a small present (the common tradition is a 500 franc note and a piece of cloth, manou, but a coffee packet, cap or speciality from home is fine). It is not needed if you have booked a tribal stay (accueil en tribu). No RBA rate for XPF. Tourisme Province Nord adds that the 500 franc note and cloth are not obligatory: the tourist's gesture is a courtesy, not the custom exchanged between Kanak.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Ask before visiting any place on customary land.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Tourisme Province Nord; Nouvelle-Calédonie Tourisme; customary chiefs.
culture-and-protocol.note: Mild difference between sources on the 500 franc note: both say the cash value doesn't matter.
